searchText: Need an EIPs repository admin (<@!187490121698770945> maybe?) to ban someone who is spamming the repository. Normally I report them and GitHub deletes their account, but this person decided to cough up the $5 for an account and so GitHub isn't banning them despite them continuing to spam. <https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/pull/3609> is latest bit of spam, but they have been spamming the repo for about a week. (I don't have rights to ban people from the repo)
